scope: A tested subset on one Windows x64 installation, not edition-wide certification. Rows may remain partial/failed.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Documents.Add, MainWindow HWND/PID, Activate, ActiveDocument IUnknown, retained Document refs
limitations: No arbitrary user-document binding or production lease implementation.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: IChemDrawDocument.SaveAs(ref object path/format/resolution/width/height); immutable path and bytes check
limitations: PowerShell late-bound and invalid-MIME calls can silently omit files. No guarantee from return alone.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Close(false), Documents.Open CDX, inventory, copy edit/save/reopen
limitations: Disposable test files only; chemistry and figure quality evaluated separately.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Independent CDXML disk open, inventory, copy edit/save/reopen
limitations: Native arrow IDs change on serialization; follow explicit saved-source aliases.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Native full-document PNG/JPEG SaveAs; inventory plus ink-scale control
limitations: Observed 600-DPI ink but approximately 144-DPI metadata. Wrong-selection/full-mask/host coverage not fully qualified.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: MakeAtom; ElementNumber, Charge, NumImplicitHydrogens, Position; native readback
limitations: Isotope/stereo CRUD and atom removal not qualified; S1 wedge preservation is narrower.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: MakeBond; Atom1/Atom2, BondOrder read; BondOrder edit and both-format reopen
limitations: Endpoint mutation, deletion and complete wedge/hash editing remain unverified.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: MakeSpline; NumPoints=6; one-based GetPoint/SetPoint; full head; save/reopen
limitations: Four-point representation failed; six-point representation is the qualified subset.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: IR LP/bond/atom ports; fragment Move; affine endpoint displacement reroutes cubic controls
limitations: Companion owns relationships. This is not vendor-maintained anchoring or complete rerouting collision acceptance.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: MakeSymbol; native LonePair symbols; Start/End; count/movement/deletion; both disk formats
limitations: Occurrence/atom association belongs to companion mappings; full chemistry/quality remains separate.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Charge positive/negative read/write and copied diagnostic charge edit/reopen
limitations: M1 still imports neutral product oxygen as +1. Preserving native chemical text fixes some import losses, not all.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Group.Objects.Move/Rotate/Scale; fragment translation; retained anti relation after rigid composition
limitations: Microfixture rotation and multi-object move are observed; no arbitrary stereo/label/anchor transform guarantee.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Objects.Clean(true); native graph, charge, carbon valence and declared double-bond stereo guards
limitations: Initial generic seed lost anti relation and was rejected. Cleanup is not complete mechanism composition.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Explicit AtomNumber occurrence mapping; retained native IDs; SupersededBy chain for arrows
limitations: No arbitrary duplicate remap; production persistence mapping incomplete; shuffled-array Composer behavior fails.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Independent CDX/CDXML fragment, spline, symbol, caption and diagnostic charge edits; reopen comparison
limitations: Automated edits on diagnostic copies only; accepted human correction time unmeasured.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: MakeArrow/MakeCaption; native step-arrow import, plus signs and captions; caption text edit/reopen
limitations: Caption edit is observed; R1 condition-specific edit and association acceptance remain unverified.

rows.backend: official installed COM interop plus native CDXML import where stated
rows.operation: Generic IR -> measured native fragments -> reaction-independent Composer -> native adapter -> readback
limitations: M1 prerequisite failed; identity-invariance and glyph clearance fail; masks/manual reference/time/owner/holdout unpassed.
